CAST("_t12"."dst" AS text)))))) WHERE ((("_t9"."kind" = CAST($17 AS text)) AND (("_t9"."src" = "_t0"."origin_id") OR ("_t9"."undirected" AND ("_t9"."dst" = "_t0"."origin_id"))) AND ((CAST($18 AS text) IS NULL) OR ("_t9"."arch_type" = CAST($18 AS text)) OR ("_t9"."arch_type" IN (SELECT "_t13"."type_name" AS "type_name" FROM "graph_types" AS "_t13" WHERE ("_t13"."ancestor" = CAST($18 AS text)))))))) AS "_t8" WHERE (("_t8"."arity" = CAST($19 AS bigint)) AND ("_t8"."arch_type" = CAST($20 AS text)) AND ("_t8"."arch_module" = CAST($21 AS text)) AND ("_t0"."depth" < CAST($22 AS bigint)))) SELECT * FROM (SELECT CAST($23 AS bigint) AS "slot", "_t0"."depth" AS "depth", "_t0"."origin_id" AS "origin_id", "_t1"."target_id" AS "target_id", "_t1"."edge_id" AS "edge_id", "_t1"."arch_type" AS "arch_type", "_t1"."arch_module" AS "arch_module", "_t1"."ord" AS "ord", "_t1"."arity" AS "arity" FROM "_cte0" AS "_t0" LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "_t4"."id" AS "target_id", "_t3"."id" AS "edge_id", "_t4"."arch_type" AS "arch_type", "_t4"."arch_module" AS "arch_module", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "_t3"."seq" ASC, "_t3"."id" ASC) AS "ord", COUNT(*) OVER () AS "arity" FROM "anchors" AS "_t3" INNER JOIN "anchors" AS "_t4" ON (("_t4"."id" = (CASE WHEN ("_t3"."src" = "_t0"."origin_id") THEN "_t3"."dst" ELSE "_t3"."src" END)) AND ("_t4"."kind" = CAST($24 AS text)) AND ((CAST($25 AS text) IS NULL) OR ("_t4"."arch_type" = CAST($25 AS text)) OR ("_t4"."arch_type" IN (SELECT "_t5"."type_name" AS "type_name" FROM "graph_types" AS "_t5" WHERE ("_t5"."ancestor" = CAST($25 AS text))))) AND (("_t4"."root_id" = CAST($6 AS uuid)) OR (CAST((("_t4"."props" -> CAST($26 AS text)) ->> CAST($27 AS text)) AS bigint) > CAST($28 AS bigint)) OR (((("_t4"."props" -> CAST($26 AS text)) -> CAST($29 AS text)) -> CAST($30 AS text)) ? BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY

SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
               a.root_id, a.src, a.dst, a.undirected, a.props, a.version,
               CASE WHEN a.kind = 'NodeAnchor' THEN
                   (SELECT string_agg(e.id::text, ',' ORDER BY e.seq, e.id)
                      FROM anchors e WHERE e.src = a.id OR e.dst = a.id)
               END
        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))
